clauses.scope_note: Section 8 permits the customer to report Third-Party Content the customer believes does not comply with the Terms, the Acceptable Use Policy, or law. Reporting is optional.
clauses.condition_explanation: No condition beyond the customer's belief that the content may be noncompliant is stated.

clauses.scope_note: Section 9 states that Anthropic may offer manual or automatic updates to Anthropic Software without advance notice. It does not require Anthropic to offer updates or impose a customer duty.
clauses.condition_explanation: Anthropic has discretion to offer updates; advance notice is not required.

clauses.scope_note: Section 11 requires the customer to indemnify and hold harmless the Anthropic Parties for listed losses arising from or related to the customer's breach or alleged breach; access to, use of, or alleged use of the Services, Materials, or Actions; feedback; products or services developed, offered, or made available using or in connection with the Services; violations of law or third-party rights; and specified misconduct. This represents the indemnity as a duty attached to the relevant use, not as a general permission grant.
clauses.condition_explanation: The duty is triggered when a listed loss arises out of or relates to one or more of the enumerated customer acts or circumstances. If Anthropic engages separate counsel and participates in or assumes exclusive defense and control, the customer must cooperate as reasonably requested.

obligation_items.content: Indemnify and hold harmless the Anthropic Parties against liabilities, claims, damages, expenses (including reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs), and other losses within the clause's enumerated categories.
obligation_items.object: Anthropic Parties and covered losses arising from or related to the enumerated acts or circumstances
obligation_items.trigger: A covered liability, claim, damage, expense, or other loss arises out of or relates to the customer's breach or alleged breach of the Terms; access to, use of, or alleged use of the Services, Materials, or Actions; feedback; a product or service developed, offered, or otherwise made available using or in connection with the Services; violation of applicable law or a third-party right; or actual or alleged fraud, intentional misconduct, gross negligence, or criminal acts by the customer or its employees or agents.

obligation_items.content: Cooperate with Anthropic and its separate counsel as reasonably requested.
obligation_items.object: Defense of a matter subject to the indemnity
obligation_items.trigger: Anthropic engages separate counsel and participates in or assumes exclusive defense and control of a matter otherwise subject to the customer's indemnity, and reasonably requests cooperation.

coverage_notes: The incorporated Acceptable Use Policy and other incorporated terms, and the T&S Support Center material, are not supplied; no rules from them are inferred.

Section 8's statement that Anthropic has no obligation to host or serve Third-Party Content is not modeled as a customer activity rule. Anthropic's reserved right to remove or take down Third-Party Content is provider-side moderation conduct that cannot be faithfully represented using the allowed activities and objects.
Section 9's software-terms conflict rule establishes precedence between terms; it is not represented as an activity permission or duty.
Section 10's ownership and reservation-of-rights language does not itself grant an activity permission or impose a behavioral duty.
Section 11's warranty and liability disclaimers and limitations, and its identification of intended third-party beneficiaries, are not activity constraints for this extraction.

paragraph_audit.reason: The optional customer reporting permission is modeled. The paragraph also reserves Anthropic's right to remove or take down Third-Party Content using algorithmic or human review; that provider-side moderation action cannot be faithfully represented with the allowed activities and objects. The statement that Anthropic has no obligation to host or serve the content does not impose a customer activity rule.

Anthropic's discretionary ability to offer manual or automatic software updates without advance notice is modeled. The remaining language establishes which terms control in a conflict, rather than imposing an activity constraint.

The paragraph states ownership and reservation of rights and clarifies that no rights beyond expressly granted access and use are granted. It does not itself grant an activity permission or impose a behavioral duty; no grant is inferred.

The indemnity and conditional cooperation duties in line 176 are modeled. Lines 172–175 are warranty and liability disclaimers or limitations; line 177 addresses their applicability, and line 178 identifies intended third-party beneficiaries. These do not create activity constraints for this extraction.
